title: Enlarging a compatible presentation while retaining strict diagrams
statement: Use the compatible enriched simplicial presentations of [lem-coef-enriched-simplicial-presentation], the complete algebroids of [def-coef-complete-algebroid], and the tensor, internal functor category and cotensor calculus of [lem-coef-enriched-category-tensor-calculus]. Let $\mathscr P$ be a compatible presentation, let $F:J\to\mathscr P$ be a strict simplicial representative of a small coherent enriched diagram, and let $\mathcal B$ be any complete $\mathcal V$-category. There is an enlarged compatible presentation $\mathscr P'$ containing the objects $\mathcal B$, the completed enriched tensor unit, all internal functor categories $\operatorname{Fun}_{\mathcal V}(\mathcal B,F(j))$, and every cotensor required by a prescribed small cellular calculation, together with the old presentation as a full compatible subpresentation. The representative $F$ is retained literally as the same strict simplicial functor after inclusion. The enlarged hom-quasicategories and cotensor comparisons restrict to the old ones, and the inclusion induces equivalences on the strict diagram, transformation and higher-simplex data already represented by $F$. Consequently the cellular cone simplicial sets computed in $\mathscr P'$ are canonically equivalent to those computed in $\mathscr P$, while now containing the strict diagrams with vertex $\mathcal B$ and with the tensor unit.
